programmes.show_description: Southern Staples. Guy Fieri is on the hunt for the taste of the south. In Charleston, a local football legend produces seriously good comfort food like deep-fried hot dogs. S13, Ep4
Scratch-Made Classics. Guy Fieri is travelling from east to west. He starts in Manhattan, enjoys a diner in Vancouver and authentic Mexican food in Santa Barbara. S13, Ep5
Meat Madness. Guy Fieri is on a mission to find the best meat restaurants. He visits a poultry diner in Charleston, a Cuban joint in Queens and a sausage specialist in Vancouver. S13, Ep6
Global Traditions. Guy Fieri is tasting international comfort food. British fish and chips, haggis and toad in the hole are all on the menu in Santa Barbara, California. S13, Ep7
Long Island, New York. Casey Webb heads to Long Island for an Italian chicken parmesan-pizza hybrid, a twist on a Jewish meat-and-potato tradition and a 10-scoop ice cream challenge. S5, Ep1
Delaware Beaches. Casey Webb's quest for the best takes him to Delaware for an ice cream custard that has locals lining up. Plus, he takes on a daunting surf and turf challenge. S5, Ep2
Lights, Camera, Cake. Buddy creates a cake for the Tribeca Film Festival with a popcorn-flavoured filling. Plus, a long-time customer returns to place a special order. S7, Ep11
Cake of Thrones. Buddy learns of Ralph's secret life when he is asked to make a cake of a mythical griffin. Plus, Buddy creates a worldly cake for foreign exchange students. S7, Ep12

Rick Stein cooks a flavourful boiled mutton with caper sauce. Plus, he visits a family that own highland cattle in Scotland. S1, Ep9
Rick Stein explores Scotland's fantastic produce. He cooks venison with morello cherries and hazelnut spaetzle. Plus, he tries eel straight out of the smoker. S1, Ep10
Rick begins his search for quality produce in the beautiful Northumberland countryside. Later, he shares his recipe for a tasty moussaka with aubergines. S2, Ep1
Rick visits a food festival in the Yorkshire Dales, where he gets inspiration to make a curd cheese tart. Plus, he checks out a wonderful organic veg garden. S2, Ep2
Spring Potluck Faves. Ree is making delicious springtime dishes. Her recipes include lemon and poppy seed mini scones, glazed pineapple ham and a primavera pasta salad. S21, Ep13
One-Pot Wonders. Ree Drummond cuts down on the clean-up by making four one-pot recipes using a non-stick skillet, a multi-pasta pot, a Dutch oven and an old kitchen favourite. S20, Ep1
Luxurious Chilli Con Carne. Jamie Oliver creates a luxurious Chilli con carne using a thrifty cut of beef. Plus, he makes tasty salmon tacos using leftovers. S2, Ep3
Chef Jamie Oliver aims to inspire people to eat better and spend less. He prepares meals on a budget and offers tips on how to shop smart. S2, Ep4
Best Of Barefoot: Cheese. Ina shares her favourite cheese recipes. These include spinach and cheddar soufflé, cheese canapes, and two crowd pleasers - baked brie and baked fontina. S11, Ep6
Best Of Barefoot: Dessert. Ina shares her favourite desserts. These include frozen mocha mousse, French apple galettes, balsamic strawberries, and fruit salad with limoncello. S11, Ep7
In Dessert Week, the six remaining bakers fight for a place in the quarter-final. They are tested on a tricky French dessert and Sue goes to Paris to learn the history of praline. S7, Ep7
The remaining bakers step back in time for the first-ever Tudor Week. The signature challenge is a savoury stuffed pie and the technical challenge wraps the contestants in knots. S7, Ep8
Devon. James heads for Devon to meet up with Michelin-starred chef Michael Caines. Plus, he cooks up a hearty bramble-infused guinea fowl and bacon stew. S1, Ep19
Cornwall. James Martin concludes his British adventure in Cornwall, where his travelling companion is local hero and Padstow-based chef Paul Ainsworth. S1, Ep20

With the rising cost of food and energy, Jamie Oliver is on a mission to make delicious dishes that won't break the budget. S1, Ep5
Shift 2: Simplicity. After a head-to-head elimination battle testing simplicity, the 12 remaining chefs face a tricky taste test from judge Graham Elliot. S2, Ep2
Multitaskers. Guy Fieri visits Dundalk, Maryland to try a Greek diner's menu. In Oxnard, California a restaurant has creative burgers with perfect flavours. S13, Ep8
Family Matters. Guy Fieri is visiting family-run kitchens. A Chinese restaurant specialises in hand-pulling noodles. In Brooklyn, brothers put a twist on traditional bar food. S13, Ep9
Old Faves, New Craves. Guy Fieri is joined by comedian Dennis Miller and singer Brad Paisley and they explore traditional eats alongside newcomers in Santa Barbara, California. S13, Ep10
Long Standing Legacies. Guy Fieri discovers a slice of Irish history in Annapolis. Two brothers serve up traditional food from their home country like Guinness-fried oysters. S13, Ep11
Richmond, Virginia. Casey Webb visits Richmond for a lesson on New Zealand-style savoury pies. Plus, he enjoys an elevated Jewish deli experience and a mighty burger challenge. S5, Ep3
Virginia Beach, Virginia. Casey Webb visits Virginia Beach. He enjoys a street corn fritter-topped burger, a decadent croissant-muffin hybrid and a corned beef omelette challenge. S5, Ep4
College, Cherry & Challenges. The crew welcomes spring with a Cherry Blossom cake for a local park. Plus, a student from England claims to make better cannoli than the boss. S7, Ep13
Sweet Chicken & Sweet Revenge. A local restaurant is celebrating its anniversary with chicken and waffles. Once Buddy has a taste of this combination he is totally inspired. S7, Ep14

Rick shares his recipe for fresh crayfish with chopped tomatoes, basil and spaghetti. Plus, he gets a food tour of Ludlow from talented chef Shaun Hill. S2, Ep3
Rick learns about a world-famous sticky toffee pudding that's made in the Lake District. Plus, he joins two fishermen as they catch sea trout on the River Towy. S2, Ep4

Jeffrey's Birthday Dinner. Ina Garten throws her husband Jeffrey an Italian-themed birthday dinner. She serves up bruschetta with sautéed chard and roasted Italian meatballs. S12, Ep1
Deans For Dinner. Ina throws a celebratory meal for her friend, who has been named the Dean of the Yale Architecture School. She makes a paella salad and goat's cheese platter. S12, Ep2
It's the semi-final and the bakers tackle Patisserie Week, and they must achieve the perfect French pastry. Plus, for showstopper the contestants make a multiple mini-cake bake. S7, Ep9
It's the final, and three bakers remain. The theme is Royal Bake Off, with three challenges to impress the Queen, and the signature challenge returns to the dreaded meringues. S7, Ep10
James Martin is in Hampshire to fish for ingredients in the River Test. Later, he cooks smoked trout salad and tea smoked trout with celeriac remoulade. S1, Ep1
Chef James Martin seeks out the best ingredients to make classic Italian dishes. Then, he cooks penne carbonara, smoked haddock risotto and tiramisu. S1, Ep2
James Martin hunts for the finest mushrooms in the New Forest. Later, he cooks pasta with cepes, chilli mushrooms, and a coffee and mushroom dessert. S1, Ep3
